## Our Organic Project in Sundarbans

Our raw and unprocessed honey comes from our dedicated and largest Organic Project with a network of over a thousand certified beekeepers in the Sundarbans – the most extensive mangrove forests in the world. After cyclone Alia destroyed the area's woods, fishing, and livelihood, Kejriwal Bee Care helped villagers restore beekeeping through bee boxes, forestry, and ethically acquiring organic honey. Our raw & unprocessed honey is traceable to beehives and is 100% free from chemicals, pesticides, adulteration, toxins, and antibiotics.
